title: Jalti Hui Reti Par Mazloom ka Laasha Hai
body:
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Be gor kafan ran mein Ahmed ka nawasa hai
Wo asr ka manzar wo shabbir ki tanhayi, ne paas Ali Akbar Qasim na jawaan bhayi, yoon baad Ali akabr ruqsat hui binaee, ab dur talak sheh ki annkhou mein andhera hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain pyaas ki shiddat se Asghar ka ajab alam, ba pherna hothou par reh reh ke zabban paiham, ek boond ki paani ki tarsata raha azlam, aur samne nazrou ke behta hua dariya hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain sibte nabi tanha lashkar hai hazarou ka, mazloom pa har ruq se karte hai laeein hamla, teerou ke musalle par shabbir ka wo sajda, ab shumr ka khanjar hai aur dilbare zehra hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hulqum shahedeen par ab shumr ka khanjar hai, faryaad o fughaan paiham Zainab ke laboon par hai, lilla na kar zibha zehra ka ye dilbar hai, kha rahem zara hum par kyon zulm ye karta hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye kaisi udasi hai kya alame ghurbat hain, sehme hue bacche hai tanhayi hai dehshat hai, aoulaade paiyambar par ye kaisi qayamat hai, kunbe ka nighebaan ab bimaar masiha hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Shaam qayamat ki wo jalte hue khaime, aagosh mein maayo ki wo sehme hue bacche, hothou pa Sakina ke wo dard bhare naale, be maqnayo chadar ab shabbir ka kunba hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro ro ke yeh kehti hai masoom Sakina jaan, kistarha mere dil ki taskeen ka ho samaan, baba ko bula lijiye lilla ha phoopi amma, hain neel tamacho ke tar khoon mein kurta hain
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Har aankh main aansohai matam hai shaheedo ka, har dil patasaruf hain karbal ke aaserou ka, mitne nahi hargiz gham khak nasheeno ka, duniya ka nahin sohail ab tak mazloom ka charcha hai
<<MINI>>
Jalti hui reti par mazloom ka laasha hai
